name: Google Sheets to Raghu CRM Leads

parameters.content:
## Google Sheet setup

Create a header row with these exact names:

`name`, `phone`, `whatsapp`, `email`, `source`, `campaign`, `interested_site_id`, `preferred_plot_size`, `budget`, `purpose`, `preferred_location`, `status`

Required: `name` and `phone`.

Valid source values: Google, Meta, WhatsApp, Website, Referral, Channel Partner, Other.

Valid status values: NEW, CONTACTED, FOLLOW UP, SITE VISIT, INTERESTED, NEGOTIATION, BOOKED, REGISTRATION COMPLETED, LOST.

After importing this workflow, configure the Google Sheets credential, spreadsheet ID, tab name, Supabase project reference, and service-role key.

The lead ID is generated from the phone number, so repeated rows for the same phone are updated instead of duplicated.
